scope: Opt-in existing-model gait demonstration; no production profile replacement
interpretation: Literature motivates intermittent propulsion and speed-dependent duty cycles; this single low-speed demonstration does not fit a measured individual or claim universally fixed frequency.
parameter_provenance: All numeric settings are visual/engineering hypotheses, including slow display frequency, duty cycle, speed ratios, positive speed floor and response constants. They are not species measurements or hydrodynamic simulation.
limitations: Carrier phase continues during coasts while active wave amplitude is reduced; residual motion is illustrative.
Shared fin amplitude is reduced but not stopped in coast; no fin-specific hydrodynamic control.
Speed changes retime the existing path-follow and action transition clock; this is not independent world-time steering.
Adapter uses 120 pose updates per second for a single opt-in fish; scalability is unmeasured.
